queries_run: Motorola Solutions credit rating 2026 Moody's S&P

findings.claim: 最大客戶為美國政府（多個合約、各軍種與機關），約占 2025 合併淨銷售 8%；合約多為長期，且可由客戶便利性終止。
findings.excerpt: Our largest customer is the U.S. government (through multiple contracts with its various branches and agencies, including the armed services), representing approximately 8% of our consolidated net sales in 2025.

findings.claim: 2023–2025 年沒有任何單一客戶占淨銷售逾 10%。
findings.source: SEC EDGAR 10-K FY2025 Item 8 附註 13
findings.excerpt: For the years ended December 31, 2025, 2024 and 2023, no single customer accounted for more than 10% of the Company's net sales.

findings.claim: 搜尋未見 2026 年穆迪或標普對 MSI 的評等行動；2025 年 10-K 載明 S&P 與 Fitch 重申 BBB、Moody's 維持 Baa2（此為公司自身信用，非客戶信用）。

note: 客戶為各級政府與企業，未查到客戶信用惡化或破產／降評的來源。
